questions.content:
A company is building a web-based Al application by using Amazon SageMaker.The application wil provide the following capabilities and features:ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecydle.The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company needs to use the central model registry to manage different versions of models in the application.

Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.

contents.en: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.
contents.zh: 为每个模型创建一个单独的亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）存储库。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.

contents.en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）并为每个模型版本添加唯一标签。

options.label: C
options.content: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 模型注册表和模型组对模型进行编目。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 模型注册表并为每个模型版本添加唯一标签。

options.content: Increase the numberof layers.

options.label: D

questions.content:
A company has a Retrieval Augmented Generation(RAG) application that uses a vector database to store embedings of documents.The company must migrate the application to AWS and must implement a solution that provides semantic search of text fles.The company has already migrated the text repository to an Amazon S3 bucket.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use an AWS Batch job to process the files and generate embeddings.Use AWS Glue to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.

contents.en: Use an AWS Batch job to process the files and generate embeddings.Use AWS Glue to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.
contents.zh: 使用一个AWS Batch作业来处理文件并生成嵌入向量，使用AWS Glue来存储嵌入向量，使用SQL查询来执行语义搜索。

options.label: B
options.content: Use a custom Amazon SageMaker notebook to run a custom script to generate embeddings.Use SageMaker Feature Store to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.

contents.zh: 使用一个自定义的亚马逊SageMaker笔记本运行一个自定义脚本来生成嵌入向量，使用SageMaker特征库来存储嵌入向量，使用SQL查询来执行语义搜索。

options.content: Use the Amazon Kendra S3 connector to ingest the documents from the S3 bucket into Amazon Kendra.Query Amazon Kendra to perform the semantic searches.

contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Kendra S3连接器将文档从S3存储桶摄取到亚马逊Kendra中，查询亚马逊Kendra来执行语义搜索。

options.label: D

contents.zh: 使用一个亚马逊Textract异步作业将文档从S3存储桶摄取进来，查询亚马逊Textract来执行语义搜索。

questions.content:
A company that has hundreds of data scientists is using Amazon SageMaker to create ML models.The models are in model groups in the SageMaker Model Registry. The data scientists are grouped into three categories:computer vision, natural language processing(NLP),and speech recognition.An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to organize the existing models into these groups to improve model discoverability at scale.The solution must not affect the integrity of the model artifacts and their existing groupings.

contents.zh: 为该域创建一个影子变体。配置SageMaker推理推荐器将来自特定IP地址的流量发送到影子端点。

options.label: D

一家广告公司使用AWS Lake Formation管理数据湖。数据湖包含结构化数据和非结构化数据。公司的机器学习工程师被分配到特定的广告活动中。机器学习工程师必须通过亚马逊Athena与数据进行交互，并直接在亚马逊S3存储桶中浏览数据。机器学习工程师只能访问与其分配的广告活动相关的资源。

哪种解决方案能以最具运营效率的方式满足这些要求？

一名机器学习工程师需要使用亚马逊SageMaker Canvas中的数据来训练一个机器学习模型。数据存储在亚马逊S3中，结构复杂。机器学习工程师必须使用一种能最大限度减少数据处理时间的文件格式。

哪种文件格式能满足这些要求？

An ML engineer is evaluating several MLmodels and must choose one model to use in production.The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions.

An ML engineer is evaluating several MLmodels and must choose one model to use in production.The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions.

Which metric finding shouldthe ML engineer prioritize the MOSTwhen choosing the model?
contents.zh:
一名机器学习工程师正在评估几个机器学习模型，并且必须选择一个模型用于生产环境。这些模型中误报（false negative）预测的成本远高于误报（false positive）预测的成本。

机器学习工程师在选择模型时应最优先考虑哪个指标？

questions.content:
A company has trained and deployed an MLmodel by using Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to implement a solution to record and monitor all the APl call events for the SageMaker endpoint. The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Debuggerto track the inferences andto report metrics.Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debuggerto track the inferences andto report metrics.Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger跟踪推理并报告指标。创建一个自定义规则，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger跟踪推理并报告指标。使用张量方差（tensor_variance）内置规则在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: C
options.content: Log all the endpoint invocation APlevents by using AWS CloudTrail.Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Log all the endpoint invocation APlevents by using AWS CloudTrail.Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用AWS CloudTrail记录所有端点调用API事件。使用亚马逊CloudWatch仪表板进行监控。设置一个CloudWatch警报，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: D
options.content: Add the lnvocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Add the lnvocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 将调用次数（Invocations）指标添加到亚马逊CloudWatch仪表板进行监控。设置一个CloudWatch警报，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

contents.en:
A company has trained and deployed an MLmodel by using Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to implement a solution to record and monitor all the APl call events for the SageMaker endpoint. The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh:
一家公司已使用亚马逊SageMaker训练并部署了一个机器学习模型。该公司需要实施一个解决方案来记录和监控SageMaker端点的所有API调用事件。该解决方案还必须在API调用事件数量突破阈值时提供通知。

哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A company has AWS Glue data processing jobs that are orchestrated by an AWS Glue workflow. The AWS Glue jobs can run on a schedule or can be launched manually. The company isdeveloping pipelines in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for MLmodel development.The pipelines willuse the output of the AWS Glue jobs during the data processing phase of model development.An MLengineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobswith the pipelines.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration ofthe pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs.

contents.en: Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration ofthe pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Step Functions对管道和AWS Glue作业进行编排。

options.label: B
options.content: Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines.Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names(ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs.

contents.en: Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines.Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names(ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Pipelines中使用处理步骤。配置指向AWS Glue作业的亚马逊资源名称（ARNs）的输入。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines unti the AWS Glue jobs finish running.

contents.en: Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines unti the AWS Glue jobs finish running.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Pipelines中使用回调（Callback）步骤来启动AWS Glue工作流，并在AWS Glue作业完成运行之前暂停管道。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelinesand the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order.

contents.en: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelinesand the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊EventBridge按期望的顺序调用管道和AWS Glue作业。

contents.en:
A company has AWS Glue data processing jobs that are orchestrated by an AWS Glue workflow. The AWS Glue jobs can run on a schedule or can be launched manually. The company isdeveloping pipelines in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for MLmodel development.The pipelines willuse the output of the AWS Glue jobs during the data processing phase of model development.An MLengineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobswith the pipelines.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
contents.zh:
一家公司有由AWS Glue工作流编排的AWS Glue数据处理作业。AWS Glue作业可以按计划运行，也可以手动启动。该公司正在亚马逊SageMaker Pipelines中开发用于机器学习模型开发的管道。这些管道将在模型开发的数据处理阶段使用AWS Glue作业的输出。一名机器学习工程师需要实施一个解决方案，将AWS Glue作业与管道集成。

哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A company is using an Amazon Redshift database as its single data source.Some of the data is sensitive. A data scientist needs to use some ofthe sensitive data from the database.An ML engineer must give the data scientist access to the data without transforming the source data and without storing anonymized data in the database.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure dynamic data masking policies to control how sensitive data is shared with the data scientist at query time.

contents.en: Configure dynamic data masking policies to control how sensitive data is shared with the data scientist at query time.
contents.zh: 配置动态数据屏蔽（Dynamic Data Masking）策略，在查询时控制如何将敏感数据共享给数据科学家。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a materialized view with masking logic on top of the database.Grant the necessary read permissions to the data scientist.

contents.en: Create a materialized view with masking logic on top of the database.Grant the necessary read permissions to the data scientist.
contents.zh: 在数据库之上创建带有屏蔽逻辑的物化视图（Materialized View）。授予数据科学家必要的读权限。

options.label: C
options.content: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Use Amazon Athena to create schema-on-read with masking logic.Share the view with the data scientist.

contents.en: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Use Amazon Athena to create schema-on-read with masking logic.Share the view with the data scientist.
contents.zh: 将亚马逊Redshift数据卸载到亚马逊S3。使用亚马逊Athena创建带有屏蔽逻辑的读时模式（Schema-on-read）。将视图共享给数据科学家。

options.label: D
options.content: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data.Share the dataset with the data scientist.

contents.en: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data.Share the dataset with the data scientist.
contents.zh: 将亚马逊Redshift数据卸载到亚马逊S3。创建一个AWS Glue作业来匿名化数据。将数据集共享给数据科学家。

contents.en:
A company is using an Amazon Redshift database as its single data source.Some of the data is sensitive. A data scientist needs to use some ofthe sensitive data from the database.An ML engineer must give the data scientist access to the data without transforming the source data and without storing anonymized data in the database.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
contents.zh:
一家公司将亚马逊Redshift数据库作为其唯一数据源。部分数据是敏感数据。一名数据科学家需要使用数据库中的部分敏感数据。一名机器学习工程师必须在不转换源数据且不在数据库中存储匿名化数据的情况下，让数据科学家能够访问这些数据。

哪种解决方案能以最少的实施工作量满足这些要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer is using a training job to fine-tune a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker Studio. The ML engineer previously used the same pre-trained model with a similar dataset. The ML engineer expects vanishing gradient, underutilized GPU, and overfiting problems. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution to detect these issues and to react in predefined ways when the issues occur. The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEASToperational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job.Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service(Amazon SNS) topic.Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job.Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service(Amazon SNS) topic.Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用TensorBoard监控训练作业。将发现结果发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。创建一个AWS Lambda函数来消费结果并启动预定义的操作。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon CloudWatch默认指标来了解训练作业。使用这些指标调用AWS Lambda函数来启动预定义的操作。

options.label: C
options.content: Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 在Amazon CloudWatch中扩展指标，包括每个训练步骤中的梯度。使用这些指标调用AWS Lambda函数来启动预定义的操作。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job.Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job.Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger内置规则监控训练作业。配置规则以启动预定义的操作。

contents.en:
An ML engineer is using a training job to fine-tune a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker Studio. The ML engineer previously used the same pre-trained model with a similar dataset. The ML engineer expects vanishing gradient, underutilized GPU, and overfiting problems. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution to detect these issues and to react in predefined ways when the issues occur. The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEASToperational overhead?
contents.zh:
一位机器学习工程师正在使用训练作业在Amazon SageMaker Studio中微调一个深度学习模型。机器学习工程师之前使用了相同的预训练模型和类似的数据集。机器学习工程师预计会出现梯度消失、GPU利用率不足和过拟合问题。机器学习工程师需要实现一个解决方案来检测这些问题，并在问题发生时以预定义的方式做出反应。解决方案还必须在训练期间提供全面的实时指标。

哪种解决方案将以最小的运营开销满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A credit card company has a fraud detection model in production on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.The company develops a new version of the model. The companyneeds to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule.

contents.en: Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule.
contents.zh: 设置SageMaker Debugger并创建自定义规则。

options.label: B
options.content: Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting.

contents.en: Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting.
contents.zh: 设置蓝/绿部署，并进行一次性流量切换。

options.label: C
options.content: Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting.

contents.en: Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting.
contents.zh: 设置蓝/绿部署，并进行金丝雀流量切换。

options.label: D
options.content: Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model.

contents.en: Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model.
contents.zh: 设置影子测试，使用新模型的影子变体。

contents.en:
A credit card company has a fraud detection model in production on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.The company develops a new version of the model. The companyneeds to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家信用卡公司在Amazon SageMaker端点上生产了一个欺诈检测模型。该公司开发了模型的新版本。该公司需要使用实时数据评估新模型的性能，且不影响生产端用户。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A company storestime-series data about user clicks in an Amazon S3 bucket.The raw data consists of milions of rows of user activity every day.ML engineers access the data to developtheir ML models. The ML engineers need to generate daily reports and analyze click trends over the past 3 days by using Amazon Athena. The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data.

Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?

options.label: A
options.content: Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket.Manually move data that is older than 30 daysto separate S3 buckets.

contents.en: Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket.Manually move data that is older than 30 daysto separate S3 buckets.
contents.zh: 保留S3桶中所有未分区的时序数据。手动将超过30天的数据移动到单独的S3桶中。

options.label: B
options.content: Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 创建AWS Lambda函数将时序数据复制到单独的S3桶中。应用S3生命周期策略，将超过30天的数据存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

options.label: C
options.content: Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 在S3桶中按日期前缀组织时序数据分区。应用S3生命周期策略，将超过30天的分区存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

options.label: D
options.content: Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket.Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket.Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 将每天的时序数据放入其自己的S3桶中。使用S3生命周期策略将持有超过30天数据的S3桶存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

contents.en:
A company storestime-series data about user clicks in an Amazon S3 bucket.The raw data consists of milions of rows of user activity every day.ML engineers access the data to developtheir ML models. The ML engineers need to generate daily reports and analyze click trends over the past 3 days by using Amazon Athena. The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data.

Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?
contents.zh:
一家公司在Amazon S3桶中存储有关用户点击的时序数据。原始数据包括每天数百万行的用户活动数据。机器学习工程师访问这些数据以开发他们的机器学习模型。机器学习工程师需要生成每日报告，并使用Amazon Athena分析过去3天的点击趋势。公司必须在将数据存档前保留数据30天。

哪种解决方案将为数据检索提供最高的性能？

questions.content:
A company has deployed an ML model that detects fraudulent credit card transactions in real time in a banking aplication.The model uses Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.Consumers are reporting delays in receiving the inference results. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to improve the inference performance. The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker实时推理进行推理。使用SageMaker模型监控提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker batch transform for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker batch transform for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker批量转换进行推理。使用SageMaker模型监控提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker无服务器推理进行推理。使用SageMaker推理推荐器提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: D
options.content: Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 继续使用SageMaker异步推理进行推理。使用SageMaker推理推荐器提供有关模型质量的通知。

contents.en:
A company has deployed an ML model that detects fraudulent credit card transactions in real time in a banking aplication.The model uses Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.Consumers are reporting delays in receiving the inference results. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to improve the inference performance. The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh:
一家公司部署了一个实时检测欺诈性信用卡交易的机器学习模型在一个银行应用中。该模型使用Amazon SageMaker异步推理。消费者报告说在接收推理结果时有延迟。一位机器学习工程师需要实现一个解决方案来提高推理性能。解决方案还必须在模型质量发生偏差时提供通知。

哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to host a trained ML model. The rate of requests to the model will be inconsistent throughout the day. The ML engineer needs a scalable solution that minimizes costs when the model is not in use. The solution also must maintain the model's capacity to respond to requests during times of peak usage.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model.Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model.

contents.en: Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model.Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model.
contents.zh: 创建具有固定并发性的AWS Lambda函数来托管模型。配置Lambda函数根据对模型的请求数量自动扩展。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate.Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage.

contents.en: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate.Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage.
contents.zh: 在使用AWS Fargate的Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群上部署模型。设置一个静态任务数量来处理高峰使用期间的请求。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到Amazon SageMaker端点。在端点部署多个模型副本。创建一个应用负载均衡器，在端点的不同模型副本之间路由流量。

options.label: D
options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically.

questions.content:

contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊SageMaker批量转换作业来处理S3存储桶中的所有图像。

options.label: B
options.content: Create an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint and a scaling policy.Run a script to make an inference request for each image.

contents.en: Create an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint and a scaling policy.Run a script to make an inference request for each image.
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊SageMaker异步推理端点和一个缩放策略。运行一个脚本，为每个图像发起推理请求。

questions.content:

options.content: Use the Natural Language Toolkit(NLTK) library on Amazon EC2 instances for text pre-processing.Use the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to identify and extract relevant keywords.

contents.en: Use the Natural Language Toolkit(NLTK) library on Amazon EC2 instances for text pre-processing.Use the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to identify and extract relevant keywords.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊EC2实例上使用自然语言工具包（NLTK）库进行文本预处理。使用潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）算法来识别并提取相关关键词。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker and the BlazingText algorithm.Apply custom pre-processing steps for stemming and removal of stop words. Calculate term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) scores to identify and extract relevant keywords.

options.content: Store the documents in an Amazon S3 bucket.Create AWS Lambda functions to process the documents and to run Python scripts for stemming and removal of stop words.Use bigram and trigram techniques to identify and extract relevant keywords.

contents.en: Store the documents in an Amazon S3 bucket.Create AWS Lambda functions to process the documents and to run Python scripts for stemming and removal of stop words.Use bigram and trigram techniques to identify and extract relevant keywords.
contents.zh: 将文档存储在亚马逊S3存储桶中。创建AWS Lambda函数来处理文档，并运行Python脚本进行词干提取和停用词去除。使用二元词组和三元词组技术来识别并提取相关关键词。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Comprehend custom entity recognition and key phrase extraction to identify and extract relevant keywords.

contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Comprehend自定义实体识别和关键短语提取来识别并提取相关关键词。

An ML engineer needs to use AWS services to identify and extract meaningful unique keywords from documents.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

一位机器学习工程师需要使用AWS服务从文档中识别并提取有意义的独特关键词，

哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

Acompany wants to develop an MLmodel by using tabular data from its customers.The data contains meaningful ordered features with sensitive information that should not be discarded.An ML engineer must ensure that the sensitive data is masked before another team starts to build the model.

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the models by using Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. Use Amazon EventBridge to monitor the data quality and to send alerts.

contents.zh: 使用亚马逊弹性容器服务（Amazon ECS）在AWS Fargate上部署模型，使用亚马逊EventBridge来监控数据质量并发送警报。

An ML engineer needs to deploy ML models to get inferences from large datasets in an asynchronous manner.The ML engineer also needs to implement scheduled monitoring of the data quality of the models.The ML engineer must receive alerts when changes in data quality occur.

questions.content:
An ML engineer normalized training data by using min-max normalization in AWS Glue DataBrew. The ML engineer must normalize the production inference data in the same way as the training data before passing the production inference data to the model for predictions.

contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊S3存储桶。使用亚马逊S3的挂载点（Mountpoint for Amazon S3）将S3存储桶与FSx for ONTAP文件系统相链接。

questions.content:
A company regularly receives new training data from the vendor of an ML model. The vendor delivers cleaned and prepared data to the company's Amazon S3 bucket every 3-4 days. The company has an Amazon SageMaker pipeline to retrain the model.An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to run the pipeline when new data is uploaded tothe S3 bucket.

options.label: A

contents.zh: 创建一个S3生命周期规则，将数据传输到SageMaker训练实例并启动训练。

options.label: B
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket.Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket.Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.
contents.zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数来扫描S3存储桶。对该Lambda函数进行编程，使其在新数据上传时启动管道。

options.label: C

contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊EventBridge规则，其事件模式与S3上传相匹配。将管道配置为该规则的目标。

options.label: D

contents.zh: 使用SageMaker管道及其与SageMaker实验的集成来管理整个机器学习工作流程。使用SageMaker实验来记录实验的运行历史以及进行审计和合规性验证。

A company is using Amazon SageMaker to create ML models.The company's data scientists need fine-grained control of the ML workflows that they orchestrate.The data scientists also need the abiliy to visualize SageMaker jobs and workflows as a directed acyclic graph(DAG). questions.content:

options.content: Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).

contents.en: Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to merge and transform data from two sources to retrain an existing ML model. One data source consists of .csv files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each .csv file consists of millions of records. The other data source is an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. The result of the merge process must be written to a second S3 bucket. The ML engineer needs to perform this merge-and-transform task every week. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data.

contents.en: Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data.
contents.zh: 每周创建一个临时的亚马逊 EMR 集群。使用该集群运行一个 Apache Spark 作业来合并并转换数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data.

contents.en: Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data.
contents.zh: 创建一个每周执行的 AWS Glue 作业，该作业使用 Apache Spark 引擎。使用 DynamicFrame 原生操作来合并并转换数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster.
contents.zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数每周运行 Apache Spark 代码来合并并转换数据。将 Lambda 函数配置为连接到初始 S3 存储桶和数据库集群。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket.

contents.en: Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 创建一个 AWS Batch 作业，该作业每周在亚马逊 EC2 实例上运行 Apache Spark 代码。将 Spark 代码配置为将数据从 EC2 实例保存到第二个 S3 存储桶。

contents.en: An ML engineer needs to merge and transform data from two sources to retrain an existing ML model. One data source consists of .csv files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each .csv file consists of millions of records. The other data source is an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. The result of the merge process must be written to a second S3 bucket. The ML engineer needs to perform this merge-and-transform task every week. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师需要合并并转换来自两个数据源的数据，以重新训练一个现有的机器学习模型。一个数据源是存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中的 .csv 文件。每个 .csv 文件包含数百万条记录。另一个数据源是一个亚马逊 Aurora 数据库集群。合并过程的结果必须写入第二个 S3 存储桶。该机器学习工程师需要每周执行一次这种合并和转换任务。哪种解决方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些需求？

questions.content: An ML engineer has deployed an Amazon SageMaker model to a serverless endpoint in production. The model is invoked by the InvokeEndpoint API operation. The model's latency in production is higher than the baseline latency in the test environment. The ML engineer thinks that the increase in latency is because of model startup time. What should the ML engineer do to confirm or deny this hypothesis?

options.label: A
options.content: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality.

contents.en: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality.
contents.zh: 安排一个 SageMaker 模型监控器作业。观察有关模型质量的指标。

options.label: B
options.content: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled.

contents.en: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled.
contents.zh: 安排一个启用了亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标的 SageMaker 模型监控器作业。

options.label: C
options.content: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.

contents.en: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.
contents.zh: 启用亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标。观察 SageMaker 命名空间中的 ModelSetupTime 指标。

options.label: D

contents.en: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelLoadingWaitTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.
contents.zh: 启用亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标。观察 SageMaker 命名空间中的 ModelLoadingWaitTime 指标。

What should the ML engineer do to confirm or deny this hypothesis?

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to ensure that a dataset complies with regulations for personally identifiable information (PII). The ML engineer will use the data to train an ML model on Amazon SageMaker instances. SageMaker must not use any of the PII. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.label: A
options.content: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Access the S3 bucket from the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Access the S3 bucket from the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 调用从数据中编辑掉 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。从SageMaker 实例访问 S3 存储桶以进行模型训练。

options.label: B
options.content: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 调用从数据中编辑掉 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊弹性文件系统（Amazon EFS）中。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到 SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to cleanse the dataset of PII. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to cleanse the dataset of PII. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 清除数据集中的 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊弹性文件系统（Amazon EFS）中。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到 SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Macie for automatic discovery of PII in the data. Remove the PII. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use Amazon Macie for automatic discovery of PII in the data. Remove the PII. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Macie 自动发现数据中的 PII。移除 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。将 S3 存储桶挂载到SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

contents.en: An ML engineer needs to ensure that a dataset complies with regulations for personally identifiable information (PII). The ML engineer will use the data to train an ML model on Amazon SageMaker instances. SageMaker must not use any of the PII. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师需要确保一个数据集符合个人身份信息（PII）相关法规。该机器学习工程师将使用这些数据在亚马逊SageMaker 实例上训练一个机器学习模型。SageMaker 不得使用任何 PII。哪种解决方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

questions.content: A company must install a custom script on any newly created Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps.

contents.en: Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps.
contents.zh: 创建一个生命周期配置脚本，以便在创建新的 SageMaker 笔记本时安装自定义脚本。在创建新的 SageMaker 笔记本的步骤中，将生命周期配置附加到每个新笔记本上。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook.

contents.en: Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook.
contents.zh: 创建一个包含自定义脚本的自定义亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）镜像。将 ECR 镜像推送到 Docker 注册表。将 Docker 镜像附加到 SageMaker Studio 域。选择要作为 SageMaker 笔记本一部分运行的内核。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script.

contents.en: Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script.
contents.zh: 创建一个自定义包索引存储库。使用 AWS CodeArtifact 管理自定义脚本的安装。设置 AWS 私有链接终端节点，将CodeArtifact 连接到 SageMaker 实例。安装脚本。

options.label: D
options.content: Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized.

contents.en: Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized.
contents.zh: 将自定义脚本存储在亚马逊 S3 中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于在新的 SageMaker 笔记本上安装自定义脚本。配置亚马逊 EventBridge 在初始化新的 SageMaker 笔记本时调用 Lambda 函数。

contents.en: A company must install a custom script on any newly created Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
contents.zh: 一家公司必须在任何新创建的亚马逊 SageMaker 笔记本实例上安装一个自定义脚本。哪种解决方案能以最少的运维开销满足这一需求？

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon Data Firehose to ingest the data. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Data Firehose to ingest the data. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transform the data. Use Amazon Athena to process the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transform the data. Use Amazon Athena to process the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Kinesis 数据流摄取数据。使用亚马逊 Data Firehose 转换数据。使用亚马逊 Athena 处理数据。使用亚马逊 QuickSight 可视化数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use AWS Glue with PySpark to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use AWS Glue with PySpark to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data. Use the built-in Flink dashboard to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data. Use the built-in Flink dashboard to visualize the data.

contents.en: A company is building a real-time data processing pipeline for an ecommerce application. The application generates a high volume of clickstream data that must be ingested, processed, and visualized in near real time. The company needs a solution that supports SQL for data processing and Jupyter notebooks for interactive analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司正在为一个电子商务应用程序构建一个实时数据处理管道。该应用程序会生成大量的点击流数据，这些数据必须近乎实时地进行摄取、处理和可视化。该公司需要一个支持使用 SQL 进行数据处理、使用 Jupyter 笔记本进行交互式分析的解决方案。哪种解决方案能满足这些需求？

questions.content: A medical company needs to store clinical data. The data includes personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI). An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to ensure that the PII and PHI are not used to train ML models. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 将临床数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 对 PII 和 PHI 进行掩码处理。

options.label: B
options.content: Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 将临床数据上传到亚马逊 Redshift 数据库。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用内置的 SQL 存储过程自动对 PII 和 PHI进行分类和掩码处理。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用亚马逊 Comprehend 检测并掩码 PII。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用亚马逊Comprehend Medical 检测并掩码 PHI信息。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training.

questions.content: An ML engineer is developing a classification model. The ML engineer needs to use custom libraries in processing jobs, training jobs, and pipelines in Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will provide this functionality with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Manually install the libraries in the SageMaker containers.

contents.en: Manually install the libraries in the SageMaker containers.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker容器中手动安装这些库。

options.label: B
options.content: Build a custom Docker container that includes the required libraries. Host the container in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.

contents.en: Build a custom Docker container that includes the required libraries. Host the container in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.
contents.zh: 构建包含所需库的自定义Docker容器。将容器托管在Amazon弹性容器 registry（Amazon ECR）中。在SageMaker作业和管道中使用ECR镜像。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a SageMaker notebook instance to host the jobs. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the libraries on the notebook instance when the notebook instance starts. Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker notebook instance to host the jobs. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the libraries on the notebook instance when the notebook instance starts. Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker笔记本实例来托管作业。创建一个AWS Lambda函数，在笔记本实例启动时在该实例上安装库。配置SageMaker作业和管道在笔记本实例上运行。

options.label: D
options.content: Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.

contents.en: Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.
contents.zh: 在Amazon EC2实例上外部运行库的代码。将结果存储在Amazon S3中。将结果导入SageMaker作业和管道。

contents.en: An ML engineer is developing a classification model. The ML engineer needs to use custom libraries in processing jobs, training jobs, and pipelines in Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will provide this functionality with the LEAST implementation effort?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师正在开发一个分类模型。该工程师需要在Amazon SageMaker的处理作业、训练作业和管道中使用自定义库。哪种解决方案能以最少的实施工作量提供此功能？

questions.content: An ML engineer is deploying a trained model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The ML engineer needs to receive alerts when data quality issues occur in production. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch metricalarm and a corresponding action to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification.

contents.en: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch metricalarm and a corresponding action to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification.
contents.zh: 配置Amazon CloudWatch指标警报和相应的操作，以发送Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）通知。

options.label: B
options.content: Integrate the SageMaker endpoint with a SageMaker Clarify processing job. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts.

contents.en: Integrate the SageMaker endpoint with a SageMaker Clarify processing job. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts.
contents.zh: 将SageMaker端点与SageMaker Clarify处理作业集成。配置Amazon CloudWatch警报以提供警报。

options.label: C
options.content: Configure a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Integrate Model Monitor with Amazon CloudWatch to provide alerts.

contents.en: Configure a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Integrate Model Monitor with Amazon CloudWatch to provide alerts.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker模型监控中配置监控作业。将模型监控与Amazon CloudWatch集成以提供警报。

options.label: D

contents.en: Configure a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler. Integrate Data Wrangler with Amazon CloudWatch to provide alerts.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Data Wrangler中配置数据流。将Data Wrangler与Amazon CloudWatch集成以提供警报。

contents.zh: Amazon FSx for Lustre文件系统

questions.content: A company has an ML model that is deployed to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference. The company needs to deploy a new model. The company must compare the new model’s performance to the currently deployed model’s performance before shifting all traffic to the new model. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints.

contents.en: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints.
contents.zh: 将新模型部署到单独的端点。手动在两个端点之间分配流量。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints.

contents.en: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints.
contents.zh: 将新模型部署到单独的端点。使用Amazon CloudFront在两个端点之间分配流量。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation.

contents.en: Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation.
contents.zh: 将新模型作为影子变体部署在与当前模型相同的端点上。将一部分实时流量路由到影子模型进行评估。

options.label: D
options.content: Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model.

contents.en: Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model.
contents.zh: 使用带有自定义逻辑的AWS Lambda函数在当前模型和新模型之间路由流量。

contents.zh: 使用AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户管理的密钥加密训练数据。

contents.zh: 重新配置训练作业以仅使用AWS Nitro实例。

contents.zh: 使用AWS PrivateLink通过接口VPC端点访问Amazon Bedrock。

contents.en: Configure Amazon Bedrock to use the private subnet where the EC2 instances are deployed.
contents.zh: 配置Amazon Bedrock使用EC2实例所在的私有子网。

contents.en: Link the existing VPC to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Direct Connect connection.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Direct Connect连接将现有VPC链接到Amazon Bedrock。

contents.en: Use Amazon EventBridge to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached).
contents.zh: 使用Amazon EventBridge摄入社交媒体数据。使用AWS Glue转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon ElastiCache（Memcached）中。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Lambda to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon S3.

contents.zh: 使用Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）摄入社交媒体数据。使用AWS Lambda转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon S3中。

questions.content: A company has an existing Amazon SageMaker model (v1) on a production endpoint. The company develops a new model version (v2) and needs to test v2 in production before substituting v2 for v1. The company needs to implement a solution to minimize the risk of v2 generating incorrect output in production. The solution must prevent any disruption of production traffic during the change to v2. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 为v2创建第二个生产变体。将1%的流量分配给v2，99%的流量分配给v1。将v2的所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将所有流量切换到v2。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 为v2创建第二个生产变体。将10%的流量分配给v2，90%的流量分配给v1。将v2的所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将所有流量切换到v2。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 将v2部署到新的端点。开启生产端点的数据捕获。编写一个脚本将100%的输入数据传递给v2。如果v2表现符合预期，停用v1端点并将流量定向到v2。

options.label: D
options.content: Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production.

contents.en: Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production.
contents.zh: 将v2部署为影子变体，采样100%的推理请求。将所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将v2推广到生产。

questions.content: An ML engineer is training an ML model to identify people’s health risk based on 20 features and 1 target. The target class has two values: •Likely to have health risk (positive class) • Unlikely to have health risk (negative class) The age range of people in the dataset is 30 years old to 60 years old. Age is one of the features. The ML engineer analyzes the features. For the positive class, the difference in proportions of labels (DPL) value is (+0.9) for the age range of 40 to 45 compared with all other age ranges. What should the ML engineer do to correct this data imbalance?

options.label: A
options.content: Oversample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.

contents.en: A company has trained an ML model that is packaged in a container. The company will integrate the model with an existing Python web application. questions.content: A company deployed an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to an endpoint by calling the CreateModel API operation. The traffic to the S3 bucket must not travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway.

contents.en: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway.
contents.zh: 创建网络地址转换（NAT）网关，配置安全组以允许出站连接，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该NAT网关

options.label: B
options.content: Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

contents.en: Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建网关型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，配置端点策略以限制对目标S3存储桶的访问，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

options.label: C

contents.en: Create an interface VPC endpoint. Verify that the security group allows only inbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建接口型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，确认安全组仅允许入站连接，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

options.label: D
options.content: Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

contents.en: Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建网关负载均衡器型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，配置身份与访问管理（IAM）策略以限制对目标S3存储桶的访问，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

questions.content: A company collects customer data every day. The company stores the data as compressed files in an Amazon S3 bucket that is partitioned by date. Every month, analysts download the data, process the data to check the data quality, and then upload the data to Amazon QuickSight dashboards. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to automatically check the data quality before the data is sent to QuickSight. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality.

contents.en: Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality.
contents.zh: 每月运行一次AWS Glue爬虫以更新AWS Glue数据目录，使用AWS Glue数据质量规则检查数据质量

options.label: B
options.content: Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality.

contents.en: Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue触发器每月运行一次AWS Glue爬虫以更新AWS Glue数据目录，创建一个AWS Glue任务，将数据加载至PySpark数据帧（DataFrame），并配置该任务通过自定义函数评估数据质量

options.label: C
options.content: Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket.

contents.en: Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 每月运行部署在AWS Lambda函数中的Python脚本评估数据质量，配置S3存储桶在有对象添加时触发该Lambda函数

options.label: D
options.content: Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality.

contents.en: Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality.
contents.zh: 配置S3存储桶在有对象上传时向亚马逊简单队列服务（SQS）发送事件通知，每月通过亚马逊CloudWatch Insights分析该SQS队列，评估数据质量

contents.en: A company collects customer data every day. The company stores the data as compressed files in an Amazon S3 bucket that is partitioned by date. Every month, analysts download the data, process the data to check the data quality, and then upload the data to Amazon QuickSight dashboards. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to automatically check the data quality before the data is sent to QuickSight. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
contents.zh: 某公司每天都会收集客户数据，并将其以压缩文件的形式存储在按日期分区的亚马逊S3存储桶中。每个月，分析师都会下载这些数据，进行数据质量检查，随后将数据上传至亚马逊QuickSight仪表板。一名机器学习工程师需要实施一套解决方案，在数据发送至QuickSight之前自动完成数据质量检查。以下哪项解决方案能够以最低的运维成本满足需求？

questions.content: A company has an ML model in Amazon SageMaker AI. An ML engineer needs to implement a monitoring solution to automatically detect changes in the input data distribution of model features. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality.

contents.en: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality.
contents.zh: 配置SageMaker模型监控器，建立数据质量基线，确保基线约束文件中启用了emit_metrics选项，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在相关数据质量指标发生变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: B
options.content: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics.

contents.en: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics.
contents.zh: 配置SageMaker模型监控器，建立模型质量基线，确保基线约束文件中的comparison_method选项设置为Robust，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在模型质量指标发生变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes.
contents.zh: 使用带有自定义规则的SageMaker Debugger跟踪特征分布的变化，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在规则检测到显著变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution.
contents.zh: 直接通过亚马逊CloudWatch监控SageMaker人工智能端点的性能指标，手动分析CloudWatch日志，以发现数据漂移或特征分布变化的迹象

questions.content: A company runs an Amazon SageMaker AI domain in a public subnet of a newly created VPC. The network is configured properly, and ML engineers can access the SageMaker AI domain. Recently, the company discovered suspicious traffic to the domain from a specific IP address. The company needs to block traffic from the specific IP address. Which update to the network configuration will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain.

contents.en: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一条安全组入站规则，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的流量，并将该安全组关联至该域

options.label: B
options.content: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network ACL for the subnet where the domain is located.

contents.en: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network ACL for the subnet where the domain is located.
contents.zh: 创建一条网络访问控制列表（NACL）入站规则，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的流量，并将该规则添加至该域所在子网的默认网络访问控制列表（NACL）

options.label: C
options.content: Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint.

contents.en: Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint.
contents.zh: 为该域创建一个影子变体，配置SageMaker推理推荐器将来自该特定IP地址的流量发送至影子端点

options.label: D
options.content: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain.

contents.en: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一个虚拟私有云（VPC）路由表，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的入站流量，并将该路由表关联至该域

questions.content: A company stores user clickstream data in an Amazon S3 bucket in AWS Account A The company needs to use the data to train an ML model in Amazon SageMaker AI in AWS Account B The training will take 10 days. The company needs to use only private IP addresses in the training. The company also must make sure that no training metadata is shared with AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
